subject: Cross-border residency workshop — scheduling and options
messages:
From: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Wed like to run a technical deep-dive with the goal of validating Redwoods multi-region residency approach (EU / US / APAC) and to align on deployment runbooks for our teams in Paris, San Francisco and Singapore. Key objectives:

- Confirm control plane / data plane separation for EU workloads
- Walk through failover & routing policies across zones
- Review audit/log retention and SOC2 evidence paths

Tentative attendees on our side: Sophie Tremblay (infra lead, Paris), Rajiv Shah (platform, Singapore), Olivia Chen (product, SF). Were looking at the week of Dec 6–10. Do you have 60–90 minute slots available? Preferably mid-day CET so Paris + Singapore can both join.

Im attaching our residency requirements workbook so you can see the list of questions we'll want covered.

Attachments: acme-residency-reqs.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)

Thanks,
Sophie Tremblay
Infra Lead, Acme Retail
Sophie.Tremblay@acme-eu.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the detail and the workbook. Wed be happy to run a focused architecture session. Proposed options (all 75 min, with timezone conversions):

1) Tue Dec 8, 10:00–11:15 CET (01:00–02:15 PST / 17:00–18:15 SGT)
2) Wed Dec 9, 13:00–14:15 CET (04:00–05:15 PST / 20:00–21:15 SGT)
3) Thu Dec 10, 08:00–09:15 CET (23:00–00:15 PST previous day / 16:00–17:15 SGT)

If none of these work we can propose splitting into two shorter sessions to cover EU/US and APAC-specific concerns.

Ive attached a draft agenda and a short pre-read so your team can mark must-have items. Vivek (cc'd) will lead the architecture walk-through. Marissa (cc'd) will coordinate logistics and follow-ups.

Attachments: RI-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF, 68KB)

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T07:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for sending the workbook. Were happy to pencil in one of Logans proposed times. Quick note from our side: can we also schedule a 30-minute pre-call with your security/compliance owner to surface any gating evidence (e.g., retention windows, encryption at rest KMS patterns) so Vivek can tailor the deep-dive?

Priyom and Karthik — can you two confirm availability for the week of Dec 6–10 (prefer mornings PST)? If not, tell us which times are impossible and well adjust.

Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@fintech-apac.co>, Olivia Chen <olivia@retail-us.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T22:10:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Hi all —

Thanks. Quick scheduling reality check: Rajiv is only available after 16:00 SGT on most days, and Olivia has a customer demo on Dec 9 morning PST. That makes some of the slots tight for full attendance.

Would Redwood be open to either:

- moving the architecture workshop to Tue Dec 8 16:00 UTC (17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT) — this keeps Paris + SF overlap but pushes Rajiv late, OR
- running a split plan: 60-min EU/US session + 45-min APAC-focused session separated by 24 hours so each region gets prime hours.

We also want to review your residency playbook and any SOC2 mappings in advance — is there a single doc you can share that lists controls + evidence locations?

Best,
Sophie
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Thanks Sophie — good context. Two quick options that might be pragmatic:

Option A: Single 75-min session on Tue Dec 8 at 16:00 UTC (converts to 08:00 PST / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT). This will be late for Rajiv but hes listed as optional if he can dial in for the critical APAC piece.

Option B: Split workshop — 60-min EU/US on Tue Dec 8 at 10:00 CET (01:00 PST / 17:00 SGT) and 45-min APAC follow-up on Wed Dec 9 at 16:00 SGT (07:00 CET / 22:00 PST previous day). This ensures Rajiv gets a workable slot and keeps sessions focused.

Im also attaching a short runbook summary and a shared Drive link with the draft agenda + previous residency notes so your team can review before the session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c456def789ghi

Attachments: runbook-summary.md (MD, 4KB)

Vivek will lead technical sections on routing and KV-cache residency. Priyom will bring the quantization and runtime compatibility notes. If Option B looks best we can send two calendar invites and a combined readout doc.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
From: Sophie Tremblay <sophie@acme-eu.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@fintech-apac.co>, Olivia Chen <olivia@retail-us.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: multi-region residency workshop

Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. After checking across the group were going with Option A: Tue Dec 8 at 16:00 UTC (17:00 CET / 08:00 PST on Redwood side). That gives Paris the overlap and Olivia can attend; Rajiv will try to join for the APAC segment but will be optional.

Please send calendar invite + dial-in and include the residency playbook & SOC2 control mapping in the invite materials. Also: can you include a short slide that lists the expected handoff points (who owns KMS keys, who manages audit logs, expected retention per region) so we can circulate to our compliance team prior to the workshop?

Looking forward to it.

Sophie Tremblay
Infra Lead, Acme Retail
